title: NFL Football
description:
Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers
The Packers host the Bears in NFL Week 5. Chicago won the last meeting, 31-27, at Soldier Field. Chicago quarterback Caleb Williams is out with a hamstring injury. Green Bay relies on QB Jordan Love, who has 1,041 passing yards and eight touchdowns.

title: NFL Football
description:
San Francisco 49ers at Seattle Seahawks
The Seahawks (3-1) host the 49ers (4-0) in NFL Week 5 at Lumen Field. San Francisco arrives atop the NFC West, but Seattle won the last meeting here 41-6 in January. Seattle looks to Sam Darnold, who has 560 passing yards and six TDs this season.

title: MLB Baseball
description:
Los Angeles Dodgers at Milwaukee Brewers
The Milwaukee Brewers meet the Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series. Milwaukee won its National League Division Series 3-1 over San Diego, and Los Angeles won its National League Division Series 3-1 over Atlanta to advance.
